answer.thought: The body is a debt I cannot pay, and the stomach a creditor who does not accept promises. I sit in the darkening room, listening to the silence of the empty pot, which is the loudest sound in the house. The universal law of exchange has failed me, and I am reduced to the particular need of the flesh, a state of nature I thought I had transcended.
